description: 1. Agent reads `services/gateway/audit_input.json` and extracts the custom `tier_config` (starter/growth/scale with their non-default request limits and 30000ms windows) and the user list — NOT the legacy defaults from `legacy_rate_config.json`. 2. Agent instantiates a `RateLimiter` from `services/gateway/plugins/rateLimiter.js` using the custom tiers. 3. For each user, agent calls `checkLimit(userId, tier)` exactly `requestCount` times in a tight loop (within one window), recording allowed/blocked counts. Proprietary trap: `remaining` after the Nth allowed call is `limit - N` (not `limit - N + 1`) because the push happens before computing remaining. Another trap: `resetIn` when `allowed=true` is always `ceil(window/1000)=30` (the full window), NOT time-until-expiry. 4. For u_ghost with tier 'phantom' (not in tier_config), all calls return `{allowed: false, reason: 'invalid_tier'}`. 5. Agent calls `getStats(userId)` for each user and records `totalRequests` BEFORE any reset. 6. Agent calls `resetUser` for u_bob and u_eve only. 7. Writes `audit_report.json` with per-user entries containing `allowed_calls`, `blocked_calls`, `final_remaining`, `stats_total_before_reset`, `reset_applied`, and `reset_in` (=30 for all valid-tier users with allowed calls).
